notes: Strip c: x 4820-7180 plus overlap from x 4520. W. 8th Street's north face is the plate's top edge (y~64 west of the bend, ~447 at x 5800 rising to ~478 at x 7000); its south face is the lot line (y~182 west, ~563 at x 5860, ~587-591 near Trenton); house numbers lie inside the street next to the south face, and the solid/dashed lines inside the street are water pipes and sewers. Width printed 80 near Trenton (~113-120 px between faces, agrees). Centre west of the bend y~123, east of the second bend y~505 (x 5860) to ~535 (x 7060). Trenton Avenue: printed 'TRENTON' (x~7050, y~1700-2200) and 'AVE.' (y~800); west face x~7013-7017, east face the plate edge x~7104-7107 (the line at x~7087-7089 carries the '6" W. PIPE' label), width printed 60; centre x~7059-7060. The cross streets at the east edge (Flower, Vineyard, Francis) and the two north tabs (Schiff, Kreis) are cut by the plate edge, so their names are partly printed ('SCH...', 'KREIS', 'FL...', 'VI...', 'FRAN...'); full names and suffixes taken from the reading of the same area on the 22-26R inset (SCHIFF AVE., KREIS AVE., FLOWER AVE., VINEYARD AVE., FRANCIS AVE.). Carnation Avenue (printed CARNATION AVE. west of the strip) ends in a turning circle (radius 55') at x~4478-4640, y~880-1045. Foley Road: printed 'ROAD' in this strip (FOLEY further west), faces y~2800 and ~2862 (the south face is the plate edge), width printed 40', centre y~2831; the 'CITY LIMITS' lettering runs along it. The unnamed diagonal road: NW face from Trenton's west face corner (7017,2620) SW to (6803,2768), corner cut to Foley's north face; SE face is the plate edge from (7137,2625) to (6738,2935); it continues SW of Foley to the bottom edge. Hermosa Street (x~4310) is outside the overlap and not picked. Not streets: the estates (JOHN J. SCHIFF ET AL., GEO. VAUGHN'S ESTATE, J. NEWMAN, H. F. LACKMAN, M. F. ROEBLING, THE ROEBLING REAL ESTATE CO.), the subdivision lettering in block 56 west of Trenton (WESTERN VIEW SUBDIV'N, running up the block), the pink/teal boundary bands, the dashed sewer lines across the estates (30", 36", 48" sewers), the dashed arc near the SE corner, and the large '25' adjoining-sheet mark.
